name: Priya Sharma
self_assessment: This year I led the migration of our payments service from a monolith to microservices, cutting deploy time from 45 minutes to 8 minutes. I mentored two junior engineers (Rahul and Meena) through their first production launches. I want to grow my system design skills further and take on more cross-team architecture work next year.

manager_feedback.text: Priya delivered the payments microservices migration two weeks ahead of schedule with zero production incidents during cutover. Her runbook for the migration is now the template for other teams. She proactively flagged the Redis connection-pool risk in Q2 before it hit production.

In Q1, Priya's on-call performance was strong — she resolved the checkout-latency incident in under 40 minutes and wrote a postmortem that led to three concrete alerting improvements. Area to develop: delegating more; she sometimes takes on fixes herself instead of coaching juniors through them.

peer_feedback.text: Priya mentored me through my first production launch (the refunds API). She reviewed 40+ of my PRs this year with detailed, kind feedback. I'm a measurably better engineer because of her — my PR rejection rate dropped from 30% to under 10%.

Priya is the engineer I most want in an incident channel. During the March checkout-latency incident she stayed calm, split the investigation cleanly, and communicated status every 15 minutes. Her migration runbook saved my team at least a week of planning.

goals.goal: Complete payments microservices migration by Q3
goals.evidence: Migration shipped 2026-06-12, two weeks ahead of the Q3 target; zero cutover incidents; deploy time reduced from 45min to 8min.

goals.goal: Mentor two junior engineers to independent production launches
goals.evidence: Rahul launched refunds API in May; Meena launched invoice-export in June. Both launched with Priya as reviewer, not author.

goals.goal: Reduce payments service P99 latency below 300ms
goals.evidence: P99 down from 520ms to 340ms as of June; caching layer work continuing into Q3.

project_outcomes.outcome: Delivered ahead of schedule; deploy time cut from 45min to 8min; zero production incidents during cutover; runbook adopted as org-wide template.
Resolved in 38 minutes; postmortem produced 3 alerting improvements that have since caught 2 issues pre-production.
